subject: Platform: approval to extend three runtime offers and comp band confirmation
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: TalentOps <recruiting@talentops.ai>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah@talentsearch.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Platform: approval to extend three runtime offers and comp band confirmation

Hi all,

We have reached verbal acceptance with three strong candidates for the runtime/platform squads and need headcount + comp-band confirmation to push official offer letters tomorrow. Quick summary: 

- Role A: Senior Platform Engineer (Runtime) — team: KV/serving runtime; candidate: Anita Patel (referred via Sarah)
- Role B: Senior Platform Engineer (Runtime) — team: compilation/kernels
- Role C: Staff Platform Engineer (Runtime infra lead) — cross-squad, high urgency (candidate identified by TalentOps)

Proposed comp bands (draft attached): Senior = L5 band (range shown in comp_band_matrix_q4.xlsx), Staff = low L6 band. Total incremental headcount: 3 (Q4 tranche). Budget code: PLAT-Q4-HEAD-2026 (finance aware).

Ask:
1) Kimberly — can you confirm budget carve-out and that these fit the published bands?
2) Karthik — do we need exec-level exception/notation for the Staff L6 ask if we land at the top of band?
3) Marcus/Soojin — any scheduling constraints for offers (start date windows, relocation sign-ons, or market adjustments)?

Attachments: comp_band_matrix_q4.xlsx, offer_draft_Mid-Sr_Runtime.pdf (draft wording).

Time is tight — recruiting is ready to send PII forms and move to formal offers. If I don’t hear flags by EOD today, TalentOps will prepare final letters for review.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Recruiting Partner, Platform Hiring
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: TalentOps <recruiting@talentops.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform: approval to extend three runtime offers and comp band confirmation

Priya —

Quick review: the attached comp band matrix checks out vs FY26 budget; finance has provisioned PLAT-Q4-HEAD-2026 for this tranche. I approve moving forward under the following constraints:

- Senior roles: authorize offers up to the 75th percentile of L5.
- Staff role (L6): we can approve up to midpoint of L6, but any request above midpoint requires an exception routed to VP of Eng (per policy).
- Pull offers into the week starting Nov 1; recruiting should offer with a start window of Nov 22–Dec 20 to avoid fiscal close conflicts.

Note: please include a 10% sign-on tie-break budget for candidates relocating out of region — route through People Ops for final approval. I've attached the same comp_band_matrix_q4.xlsx with highlighted cells.

Kimberly Park
Director, Finance — People & Compensation
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: TalentOps <recruiting@talentops.ai>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah@talentsearch.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Platform: approval to extend three runtime offers and comp band confirmation

Thanks — a couple of operational asks: 

- Can recruiting hold offers until we confirm exact manager-level hiring packet (I need to align start projects)? If offers must go tomorrow, please add a 30-day provisional project plan to the start packet so we can stage onboarding.
- For Anita Patel (Anita.patel+candidate@gmail.com), her target is above midpoint of L5; recommend we include a 6-month performance bonus clause rather than pushing to L6 now.
- Suggest we set offer expiration to 7 days instead of the default 14 to speed acceptance and lock hiring cadence.

On the quoting from Priya's earlier message:
> We have reached verbal acceptance with three strong candidates ...

If we're comfortable with verbal acceptance signals, Recruiting can draft offers conditioned on completed background checks + signed relocation forms.

Marcus Lin
VP, Platform Infrastructure

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: TalentOps <recruiting@talentops.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Platform: approval to extend three runtime offers and comp band confirmation

Looping in my concerns quickly:

- The Staff L6 candidate is exceptional, but market pressure suggests competitive compensation will land at top of L6. Per policy, anything above midpoint needs an exception. If we want to secure the candidate, I recommend a capped exception (sign-on + accelerated review at 6 months) rather than permanently expanding band.
- Please file an exception request doc (1-page) and link to the Drive folder. I've added a short note in the drive doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Platform-Hiring/Q4-comp-bands (see "L6-exception-brief").
- Also, confirm relocation budget now — if we expect +10% sign-on, we should pre-approve the People Ops pathway to avoid delays.

On timing: Nov 1 offers are fine as long as we lock candidate start windows to mid-Nov–Dec.

— Soojin
Staff Eng Manager, Runtime Teams

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: TalentOps <recruiting@talentops.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Platform: approval to extend three runtime offers and comp band confirmation

Approved with conditions — I authorize the offers under the following constraints: 

1) Senior (L5) offers: proceed up to the 75th percentile as Kimberly noted.
2) Staff (L6) candidate: exception approved up to the midpoint + 8% (one-time sign-on equivalent). Any request beyond that requires VP-level memo. Exception is conditional on:
   - A 6-month performance review tied to specific deliverables (documented in onboarding packet)
   - People Ops sign-off on relocation budget before sending offer
3) Offer expiry: set to 7 days to accelerate acceptance.
4) Recruiting: send official drafts today, include conditional language for backgrounds and the 6-month review, and route the signed offer to finance for cost posting.

Priya — please confirm and ask TalentOps to publish final letters. Marcus — work with Soojin to finalize the onboarding project notes.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Engineering — Platform & Runtime
Redwood Inference

(Approved at 16:45 PST 2026-10-30)
